title.value: Language Model Alignment with Elastic Reset
title.justification: This is the title of the paper.
title.quote: Language Model Alignment with Elastic Reset

extractions.description: The paper introduces Elastic Reset, a novel algorithm for fine-tuning language models with reinforcement learning (RL) that aims to mitigate reward hacking and language drift. It periodically resets the online model to an exponentially moving average (EMA) of itself and the EMA model to the initial model, achieving higher reward with less drift. The method is evaluated on pivot-translation, IMDB sentiment, and technical QA chatbot tasks.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper primarily focuses on improving the alignment and performance of language models using a new algorithm. While the improvements could potentially be applied to sustainability-related tasks, the central theme of the paper is not directly focused on sustainable development.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Finetuning language models with reinforcement learning (RL), e.g. from human feedback (HF), is a prominent method for alignment. But optimizing against a reward model can improve on reward while degrading performance in other areas, a phenomenon known as reward hacking, alignment tax, or language drift.
